scenes.title: Béatrice's Shoot
scenes.summary: On a grueling film set, Béatrice Dalle grows suspicious when the makeup artist is ordered to apply full-body makeup for a supposedly bagged corpse.

scenes.title: Béatrice's Call
scenes.summary: Distressed by an unexpected nude scene at the morgue, Béatrice Dalle calls Andréa on maternity leave, urging her to rush to the movie set.

scenes.title: Thirty Years of ASK
scenes.summary: Mathias shows Hicham the original studio room where ASK was founded, insisting on hosting the agency's 30th anniversary celebration right at the office.

scenes.title: The American Claim
scenes.summary: Hicham receives a registered letter from American producers demanding two million dollars over Isabelle Huppert's clandestine double shoot.

scenes.title: Thirty Years of ASK
scenes.summary: At ASK, Mathias, Andréa, and Gabriel process Hicham's furious outburst and worry about the upcoming agency anniversary.

scenes.title: Watching Flora
scenes.summary: At their apartment, Andréa begs Colette to watch baby Flora for the afternoon so she can visit Béatrice Dalle's chaotic film set, but Colette refuses due to work obligations.

scenes.title: Béatrice on Set
scenes.summary: On a chaotic film set, star actress Béatrice Dalle refuses to play a gratuitous nude scene in a morgue, prompting Andréa to confront the director and enforce the contract.

scenes.title: The Next Career Move
scenes.summary: At ASK, Sophia Leprince seeks guidance on her career after her breakout film role, venting to Camille and Hervé about objectification and waiting for Mathias.

scenes.title: Béatrice's Escape
scenes.summary: Arlette informs Andréa that Béatrice Dalle walked off the film shoot after an unwanted nude scene was demanded, while Andréa tries frantically to reach her.

scenes.title: Crisis Meeting
scenes.summary: At ASK, the agents hold an urgent crisis meeting where Mathias and Hicham clash over who is best equipped to negotiate with the producers.

scenes.title: Nighttime Visit
scenes.summary: Camille brings young actor Valentin into the darkened ASK offices after hours, warning him to remain quiet as he asks to see where she works.

scenes.title: In the Boss's Office
scenes.summary: Valentin wanders into Mathias's grand office and teases Camille about running her own agency, insisting they rehearse his scene on the sofa.

scenes.title: The Intimate Rehearsal
scenes.summary: At ASK, Camille coaches her new client and boyfriend Valentin through an audition scene. When Camille critiques his overly aggressive delivery and advises subtle film acting, Valentin takes offense and threatens to walk out before Camille apologizes.

scenes.title: The Nudity Clause
scenes.summary: Andréa confronts director Jean-Luc Birag over Béatrice Dalle's contract. While Birag claims the morgue scene qualifies as a love scene justifying nudity under the contract's ambiguous clause, Andréa furiously denounces his word games and defends her client against an exploitative demand.

scenes.title: Béatrice's Fury
scenes.summary: Furious over director Birag's underhanded demands, Béatrice Dalle refuses to return to the film set, threatening to let the production sue her. Andréa warns that ASK is financially liable for the contract, but promises she will never abandon Béatrice and will find a solution.

scenes.title: Party Preparations
scenes.summary: At the ASK reception desk, Valentin stops by to find Camille while Hervé juggles frantic logistics and deliveries for the agency's 30th anniversary celebration amidst the mounting agency crises.

scenes.title: A New Meeting
scenes.summary: At ASK, Camille successfully books an audition for Sophia Leprince, while Noémie reassures Mathias that Hicham's silence means the rival American deal is stalling.

scenes.title: No More Brace
scenes.summary: In his office, Noémie delights Mathias by revealing that her neck brace is off, playfully demonstrating her restored mobility.

scenes.title: Feigned Disappointment
scenes.summary: Mathias takes a phone call from Hicham and fakes total dismay upon hearing that Solaris signed the co-production deal, successfully hiding his undercover sabotage.

scenes.title: Late Night Visit
scenes.summary: After a painful phone argument with his ex-wife over custody of his son Elvis, a vulnerable Hicham visits Andréa late at night to hold his newborn daughter.

scenes.title: A Moment of Peace
scenes.summary: At Andréa's apartment, Hicham visits to hold baby Flora peacefully. When Colette walks in surprised, Hicham reassures her that he comes without conflict, and the three parents share a rare quiet moment of domestic peace.

scenes.title: Béatrice's Agreement
scenes.summary: On the film set, Béatrice Dalle confronts director Pascal over the shutdown caused by her refusal to shoot a nude scene. Pascal admits he panicked out of creative anxiety, and proposes an alternative where the character gently bites her ear, which Béatrice adores.

scenes.title: Hicham's Letter
scenes.summary: Returning home after resolving the film crisis, Andréa finds Colette holding a letter from Hicham addressed to the family court judge. In the letter, Hicham officially waives his parental claim so that Colette can legitimately become Flora's recognized second parent.

scenes.title: On the Edge of the Precipice
scenes.summary: In a quiet Parisian bar, Andréa enjoys her first night out since giving birth, having drinks with Hicham. Confronted by the mounting turmoil at ASK, they both admit that walking away right now would be a terrible mistake.

scenes.title: Paying the Americans
scenes.summary: At the bar table, Hicham reveals his decision to pay the American insurance claim using his own capital to save ASK. Deeply moved, Andréa realizes she must immediately cancel her secret legal registration for the rival agency.

scenes.title: The Betrayal Discovered
scenes.summary: Returning late to ASK, Hicham discovers documents proving that Andréa and Gabriel are preparing to launch a rival agency. Distraught and furious, he searches the darkened corridors for Arlette to confront this devastating betrayal.

scenes.title: Gabriel's Hesitation
scenes.summary: Gabriel tracks down Arlette in her office at ASK. Sensing that a storm is brewing, he seeks her counsel and tests the waters about the agency's loyalty before the truth erupts.

scenes.title: The Betrayal Revealed
scenes.summary: In Mathias's office, a furious Hicham reveals the voicemail exposing that Andréa and Gabriel are plotting to leave ASK to start a rival agency. Seizing on Hicham's disgust, Mathias proposes buying out his shares to reclaim ASK.

scenes.title: Gabriel's Fatal Mistake
scenes.summary: Gabriel realizes with horror that he accidentally left his confidential voicemail on Hicham's phone instead of their lawyer's. A devastating confrontation erupts at ASK as Hicham brands Gabriel and Andréa traitors and storms out to hand the agency over to Mathias.
